objective: (1 / sum rate) * sum over (location, base) of rate[location] * (0.5 * linked_load + distance_m / drone_speed_kmh * assign)

incidents.description: Out-of-hospital cardiac arrests at the location in the observation window; arrival rate = incidents / (24 * observation_days) per hour
incidents.label: cardiac arrests observed

distance_m.description: Haversine distance from the base to the location
distance_m.label: flight distance (m)

max_bases.description: Bases that may be opened, one drone each
max_bases.label: number of drones (bases opened)

maintenance_minutes.description: Prep, dispatch, cleaning and maintenance time per mission
maintenance_minutes.label: maintenance time per mission (minutes)

observation_days.description: Length of the incident window behind the arrival rates
observation_days.label: observation window (days)

decision_variables.open[base]: binary, 1 if the base gets a drone
decision_variables.assign[location, base]: binary, 1 if the base answers the location
decision_variables.queue_load[base]: V, the base's queue term (hours), 0 <= V <= Vbar

constraints.aux0[base]: queue_load == sum rate * service_time^2 * assign + sum rate * service_time * linked_load
constraints.aux1/aux2/aux3[location, base]: linked_load <= queue_load; <= Vbar * assign; >= queue_load - Vbar * (1 - assign)

assign.label: incident locations assigned to a base

linked_load.label: queue load linked to an assigned location (hours)
